updates.title: Windows Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-49179)
updates.summary: A command injection flaw in Windows Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network. This is a critical vulnerability affecting a core identity infrastructure component that administrators must patch immediately.

updates.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2026-62827)
updates.summary: An authentication bypass in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. This impacts organizations using SharePoint in hybrid or on-premises configurations where role-based access control may be circumvented.

updates.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering Vulnerability (CVE-2026-63512)
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization controls in SharePoint allow authorized attackers to tamper with content over the network. Administrators should review access policies and update SharePoint to prevent unauthorized data modification.

updates.title: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO Now Satisfy MFA as Standalone Second Factor
updates.summary: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO can now independently fulfill multifactor authentication requirements, eliminating the need for users to register a separate passkey for step-up authentication or policy enforcement. This simplifies user experience while maintaining strong phishing-resistant authentication.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Actionable Email Notifications for Incident Remediation
updates.summary: End users can now take direct remediation actions—such as stopping file sharing, deleting files, applying labels, or reporting false positives—from DLP notification emails without leaving their mailbox. This streamlines incident response and reduces administrative overhead for compliance teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Granular Classification Error Controls for Exchange Online
updates.summary: Administrators can now create fine-grained DLP policies that respond to specific classification failures (timeout, throttling, etc.) rather than applying a blanket policy to all error types. This enables more precise and context-aware data protection strategies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: FTP and SFTP Protection
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now extends to FTP and SFTP data transfers from managed devices, closing a gap in sensitive data protection for organizations that use legacy file transfer protocols. This helps prevent unauthorized exfiltration while maintaining visibility over data in motion.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: User-Based Alert Aggregation
updates.summary: DLP alerts can now be consolidated by user across multiple matched rules, reducing alert noise and simplifying investigation workflows. Security teams can more quickly identify patterns of policy violations from individual users rather than managing fragmented alerts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Advanced Review Set Explorer
updates.summary: The Advanced Review Set Explorer provides reviewers with real-time big data analytics, enabling them to identify patterns, extract data using Kusto queries, and visualize trends within discovery data. This reduces manual review effort and accelerates case investigation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: In-Product Self-Service Diagnostics
updates.summary: Built-in diagnostics help eDiscovery administrators identify and resolve common configuration issues—such as case permission and security filter problems—without contacting support. This reduces troubleshooting time and improves operational efficiency.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: AI-Powered Policy Sync & Device Health Investigation
updates.summary: AI-powered visibility tracks Endpoint DLP policy deployment across devices, proactively identifies sync failures, explains root causes, and recommends remediation actions. This helps admins quickly diagnose coverage gaps and configuration issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Reduce Endpoint Policy Sync Status SLA to 30 Minutes
updates.summary: Administrators will now see Endpoint DLP policy sync status in the Purview portal within 30 minutes instead of 2 hours, enabling faster visibility into enforcement coverage. This accelerates troubleshooting and deployment verification.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Simulation Mode for Auto-Labeling Policies
updates.summary: Organizations can now run auto-labeling policies in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled before enforcement, allowing validation of policy accuracy and distribution analysis. This reduces risk of unintended labeling at scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Network Data Security Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP policies can now intercept and inspect data at the network layer through integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access, enabling protection of sensitive data in text and AI interactions before it reaches untrusted cloud applications. This extends compliance enforcement beyond traditional endpoints.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: The Insider Risk Management alerts interface now consolidates triage and standard alerts into a single view, allowing analysts to manage both classic and agent-triaged alerts from one location with inline preview capabilities. This improves investigator efficiency and reduces context switching.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Expanded User Profile Details from Entra
updates.summary: Insider Risk alerts now display enriched user context from Microsoft Entra, including office location, employee type, department, and employment status, enabling investigators to better understand user behavior patterns and risk signals. This accelerates investigation and improves decision quality.
